descriptionChirho: To physically rise from a seated or lying position, to stand up or get up, used of ordinary bodily movement.

labelChirho: rise from the dead, be resurrected
descriptionChirho: To come back to life after death, to be resurrected, used intransitively of the one who rises from the dead.
To cause someone to rise or stand up physically, or to raise up a person or leader into prominence.
To cause someone to come back to life, to resurrect someone from the dead, used transitively of God raising a person.
